sections.heading: Investment Summary
sections.body_md:
{{VERBATIM:investment_framing}}

Pricing below covers Social Media Management, Strategy and Content Creation for the City of Newport Beach, NBPD and NBFD. Each department is priced independently so the City may award one, two, or all three service areas. All pricing is all-inclusive: labor, materials, equipment, supervision, travel, expenses, inflation and insurance are built into each fee, with no separate reimbursable line.

sections.heading: Terms
sections.body_md: Pricing is all-inclusive and will remain unchanged for the full one-year term and both optional one-year renewals. Monthly invoices will identify the person who performed the work, a description of the services and the related Scope of Services task, the date services were performed, hours spent on any hourly-billed work, and any reimbursable items — none are anticipated given the all-inclusive structure. Invoices will be paid within thirty calendar days of City approval.

internal_notes.issue: Staffing hours per monthly task (6/8/2/4 splits) are placeholder assumptions to land inside the Average band — confirm against actual expected monthly workload per department before submission.

No ceilings or implied budget limits were stated in the RFP; pricing is sized to typical Average-tier scope depth rather than to any stated cap. Cost is only 20% of the evaluation score, so pricing does not need to be maximally aggressive.
Confirm whether we are proposing on all three service areas (City, NBPD, NBFD) or a subset — pricing currently assumes all three columns are filled.

Confirm the single hourly role (Digital Team) chosen to populate the Cost File 'Hourly Rate for Additional Services' row is the right representative rate, or whether a blended/average rate across roles is preferred.

Event/Special Project Fee is quoted as a single representative per-event rate (Guide 7.4); confirm expected frequency of events per year so the annual value is understood internally even though only a per-event rate is submitted.
